_comment: Transform control for row779_template_sandbox_browser_pin.json. It must exit 1 with the mutant ESCAPED. The banded test IMPORTS bulk_downloader.app_template and asserts its __name__; it never issues a sandbox request, so a real regression in the pin decision cannot make it fail. A CAUGHT here would mean the mutation breaks import or parsing rather than behaviour, and every CAUGHT in the main battery would be worthless.
subject: transform control -- the pin-time refusal can be made to fail open and remains importable and executable, and is NOT caught by a test that only imports the subject
